findings.oracle: Helper refactored to return tuple[bytes, dict] so callers can assert both transformed bytes (e.g. NOT 0x5A -> 0xA5) and operation metadata {offset, length, operation}; new TestSetupHelperFidelity class adds explicit round-trip tests proving the helper faithfully drives the native backend

test_min_level_filter now asserts _visible_events(proxy) == ['warn_event'] (exact event identity, not just rowCount); three boundary tests added covering DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR/CRITICAL thresholds by event name, proving both inclusion and exclusion by named record

test_single_byte_layout now decomposes result into address_col, gap_after_address, hex_col, gap_after_hex, ascii_col and asserts each independently using ord('A')==0x41 as independent oracle; string-equality frozen-output assertion removed
